Stop buying shower liners that reek of chemicals.

Most cheap vinyl liners come out of the package with a sharp plastic smell that lingers for days. They also tend to cling straight to your arms and legs the second the water runs, which is its own small daily annoyance.

This one is Oeko-tex certified, meaning it's tested against a long list of harmful substances before it ever reaches your bathroom. It's a standard size, so it drops right onto a regular shower or tub rod without any guesswork.
